assets.name: forest-1
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: square overhead fantasy strategy game terrain texture. Paint sunlit oak groves. Light spring green, clearly recognizable individual trees with trunks and rounded leafy crowns, overhead slightly isometric miniature painted style. Bright dry grassy floor, warm daylight, sharp readable tree silhouettes. Fill entire square edge to edge with continuous forest, no horizon, water, marsh, fog, hex border, lettering or interface. Consistent light green palette. This is forest variation 1 for Warborn.
